description: In mail/src/server.rs line 384, mta_sts_handler calls d.domain.to_lowercase() on every element in the domains list on every request. Since 'domain' is already lowercased (line 374), the comparison should use d.domain.eq_ignore_ascii_case(domain) instead, which avoids a String allocation per iteration. P2 unnecessary allocation in request handler.
title: Idiom review iter-4: to_lowercase() alloc per iter in mta_sts_handler
